item.title: Harness Engineering Principles - Architecture Wisdom from Claude Code
item.description: Distilling Claude Code's six core Harness Engineering principles: prompts as control plane, cache-aware design, fail-closed, A/B testing everything, observe before fixing, and latching for stability - plus how to apply them to AI Agent system construction.

item.title: Agent Team Architecture Deep Dive: From Monolith to Distributed Collaboration
item.description: An in-depth look at ADK Go's Agent Team architecture, covering multi-agent collaboration topology, state consistency, fault tolerance, and production best practices.

item.title: Agent Runtime Architecture: How ADK Go Executes Agents
item.description: An in-depth look at ADK Go's Agent Runtime architecture — process model, goroutine-based concurrency, memory management, and how the Runtime interacts with Agents in production.

item.title: How Do 40+ Tools 'Grow' onto an AI?
item.description: Deep dive into Claude Code's tool system: how 40+ tools form an extensible capability architecture through unified interface contracts, three-tier filtering pipelines, and fail-closed defaults. From Tool.ts interface to buildTool factory, revealing the underlying mechanisms of AI tool calling.

item.title: Claude Code Is Not a CLI Tool, But a 'Living' System
item.description: A deep dive into Claude Code's underlying architecture: why it's not a traditional CLI tool but an intelligent system running in a 'distributed state.' From TypeScript to Bun runtime, three-tier architecture to Feature Flags, understand the core design philosophy of this AI coding assistant.

item.title: You Only Have Three Servers, Why Are You Using Kubernetes?
item.description: Kubernetes is for Google, systemd is for the rest of us. The story of someone who spent three months learning K8s, only to realize a single config file would have done the job.
